analyst_notes: Record = the fund manager CB Investment Management s. r. o. (100% owned by Crowdberry a.s.); the Crowdberry crowd-investing platform itself is an intermediary (E2) and Crowdberry's real-estate (CB Property Investors) and impact (CB ESPRI, own dossier) arms are separate. NBS register export of 2026-10-24: CB Investment Management s. r. o. registered AIF manager since 2019-08-20; CB Growth ONE s. r. o. registered AIF since 2019-08-20. Investment dates: the cbim.sk portfolio shows entry years only; the newest entries are 2023 (WageNow, WeWell, Gratitude, ErlaServers, Small Business Community), dates set to 2023-01-01 = year only. Sector 'generalist' derived from the ~32-company portfolio (fintech, biotech, agritech, SaaS, consumer, proptech). Activity check: the 2025 financial statements of CB Growth ONE (e10, filed 2026-06-12) list the same equity holdings as 2024 (incl. Vestberry 2.55%, unchanged) plus convertible loans; the only movements visible are a Wereldo loan conversion to equity and an increase of the Food Expres convertible loan (12,833 -> 112,833 EUR net), not dated; total assets fell from 13.5m to 10.3m EUR. The Recursive H1 2025 round-up lists CB Investment Management among Vestberry investors, but AIN.ua (2025-03-14) names only Seed Starter (lead), Venture to Future Fund and Zero One Hundred for the EUR 2.2m March 2025 seed and the CB Growth ONE stake did not change, so this was not counted as a new CB IM investment. Crowdberry's 2025 deals reported by aggregators (Terratico Nov 2024 with VFF, 3IPK Apr 2025, Boataround Dec 2025) were raised from Crowdberry platform investors / Crowdberry loans; none of the sources attributes them to the CB Growth ONE fund. The fund is financed by SIH (NDF II, 2019 start-up programme with Vision Ventures and Zero Gravity); the parallel Vision Ventures fund closed its investment period in Dec 2023 per SIH, CB IM's own period end is not published. Capital: EUR 23.2m fund size stated on cbim.sk (as_of = retrieval date, page undated); the 2025 balance sheet shows 23,183,550 EUR of contributed equity, consistent. Ticket EUR 200k-1.6m from the company's self-description on Profesia (D, undated). If a dated 2025-2026 follow-on or new fund is published, re-classify as include.
